experiment.rationale: Participant reports marking 2-3 seconds after impact, after stabilization. Use midpoint 2.5 seconds, not a delay selected by test performance.
experiment.scope: Temporal alignment sensitivity on previously examined data; not independent validation or full episode segmentation

capture_context.mount: Same portrait dashboard-area holder throughout all three trips
capture_context.annotation_semantics: Retrospective event reference after perceived vehicle stabilization, not impact timestamp
capture_context.limitations: Delay and stabilization are self-reported, not measured. Neighboring peaks not confirmed to share a physical cause. Mount stiffness differs by corridor.
